headlines.headline: KENTUCKY LANDS TOP TRANSFER MOMCILOVIC AS PORTAL CLOSES
headlines.detail: Kentucky won the No. 1-rated transfer (48.7% on threes) over Louisville and Arizona. Over 2,700 entered the portal; NBA Draft June 23-24.

headlines.headline: KNICKS WIN FIRST TITLE IN 53 YEARS, BRUNSON UNANIMOUS FINALS MVP
headlines.detail: New York beat San Antonio 4-1, rallying from double-digit deficits in all four wins. Brunson averaged 32.6 ppg and dropped 45 in Game 5.

headlines.headline: BLOCKBUSTER OFFSEASON: GARRETT TO RAMS, A.J. BROWN TO PATRIOTS
headlines.detail: June 1 trades sent Myles Garrett to the Rams and A.J. Brown to New England, giving QB Drake Maye a No. 1 target. Camp opens late July.

headlines.headline: PORTAL CLOSES WITH LSU ON TOP; COACHES OPEN 2028 CONTACT
headlines.detail: Lane Kiffin's LSU holds the top class after Auburn WR Cam Coleman entered. June 15 was the first day coaches could contact the class of 2028.
